mutations.label: the Outscale pack stops vouching for the region and subregion names it validates a request against, so SubregionName becomes a synthetic string, knownSubregion refuses it — the #269 invariant — and every create that names a zone replays 400

the direction of a security-group rule, the kind of a load balancer and the protocol of a listener stop being vouched for, so Inbound, internal and TCP become synthetic strings and CreateSecurityGroupRule and CreateLoadBalancer replay 400

the Outscale pack declares no ReplayInvariant again, so no value and no order of an Outscale answer is compared and the gate names the provider instead of printing "0 divergent finding(s)" over a comparison that did not happen

note: The mutation was retargeted for #399: it named TestTheCommittedCorpusPassesItsOwnGateAndSaysTheSameThingTwice, which compares two runs of the same tree and so agrees with itself on mutated counters, and it asserted a consequence — two #379 exemptions going stale — that PR #388 retired within its own branch before the spec landed. It had therefore never bitten on main. The guard it names now is per provider, which is the hole the old label described and nothing enforced.
